tips: Move with WASD, the left stick, or the left joystick.
Look around with the mouse (click the game to lock it), the right stick, or by dragging on the right side of the screen.
Hold Shift, press L3, or tap RUN to sprint. On touch, pushing the stick all the way out also starts a run.
Press C, R3, or CRCH to crouch and sneak past feeders.
Attack or fire with left click, J, RT, or the big FIRE button.
Aim with right click, LT, or AIM. On the new thumb-arc layout, a short tap toggles aim; a long press aims only while you hold it.
Reload with R, Y, or the ⟳ button.
Swap weapons with Q, RB, or ⇄.
Throw a grenade with G, LB, or the bomb button.
Jump with Space, A, or JUMP.
Dodge-roll through attacks with Ctrl, B, or ROLL.
Interact or get in a vehicle with E or F, D-pad up, or USE.
Toggle first-person with V, Back/View, or the eye button.
Pause with Esc or P, Start, or the II button.
Press H on the keyboard to use a med kit.
Tap the dialogue box or press Enter to skip a line.
In Simple controls, a short tap on the look side of the screen shoots; hold to keep firing.
Turn on Auto-fire in Control Settings to shoot when an enemy is under the crosshair.
Choose a floating joystick (appears where you touch) or a fixed one in Control Settings.
While driving, use GAS, BRAKE/REV and the arrow buttons, or the left stick and the triggers.
quotes: The quiet is never empty. Listen.
Keep Nia close. The street forgets names.
Dad always walks a step behind, just in case.
Head down. Soft steps. We go together.
There is still a home at the end of this road.
Don't waste a shot on the dark. Wait for the face.
The wind on Route 1 knows every house we left.
If the lights come back, don't trust them yet.
We are still a family. That has to be enough tonight.
notes: All 20 tips come from real controls in src/game/input.js, src/game/pctl.js, index.html touch/drive HUD, and the Controls table. Heal (H) is keyboard-only — there is no touch or gamepad heal button. Quotes are original and are not chapter end-quotes from the game.
